- **Quoting:** only fields containing a comma, double quote, CR or LF are wrapped in double quotes, with inner quotes doubled.
- **Tests:** they compare exact output strings and cover every case on your list.

The commit touches only those two new files, and `git status` is clean afterwards. Git warned that line endings in the two new files will be converted to CRLF the next time it touches them. That only affects the source files, not the exported strings.
